title: Josiah knows Max went into the woods to pray

tellings.quote: one is Josiah says you know Max went into the woods and was praying last night

plain: A child named Josiah is said to have known, without being told, that a man named Max Davis "went into the woods and was praying last night." The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a documentary called The Telepathy Tapes, tells Michels this as an example from her work, passing on what Josiah said. It would mean some children can pick up what others are doing or thinking by telepathy, that is, mind to mind.
